key_insight: By inverse-designing the nonlinear pump in a topological photonic lattice, the authors can program which entangled biphoton state is generated while preserving topological protection.
engineering_relevance: This enables application-specific, robust quantum-state sources for high-dimensional quantum communication, networking, and photonic quantum computing.
method: Build silicon photonic topological superlattices with co-localized interface modes.
Shape the optical pump into tailored superpositions to select topological biphoton eigenstates.
Inverse-engineer pump profiles to target desired Schmidt dimensionalities and modal structures.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports selective preparation of target entangled states and reproducible site-resolved two-photon correlations across nominally identical devices, indicating robustness to fabrication disorder.
watch_item: Programmability depends on precise pump shaping and device-specific mode engineering, so scalability may be limited by optical control complexity and fabrication tolerances.
paper_title: Programmable Preparation of Topological Entangled States
